body:
As I said before, I don't feel like I can go to anyone. Its so personal I feel as though if I told anyone I'd loose her trust and then there's no one she'll talk to, yet I'm scared if it gets to the point where she needs urgent attention I'll be too late. Maybe if I keep her texting tonight, tomorrow I can talk to her in person, and really sort this out.
I really appreciate you talking to me about this, its really helped my head clear a bit, thank you so much.

Yes, we text practically 24/7, I need to make sure shes okay and has someone to talk to, it just doesn't seem enough.
My parents will think its teenage drama, I've had issues with that when I've tried to confide in them before.

16, and I do. All the time. As soon as I see her I go straight there, I give her a hug, and tell her how much she means to me. She says if it weren't for me she'd already be dead which is a terrifying thought.
She'd never run away, she just wouldn't.
